title: nl80211: Dissect HT and VHT MCS and Capabilities in band attrs
description:
Dissect NL80211_BAND_ATTR_HT_MCS_SET, NL80211_BAND_ATTR_HT_CAPA,
NL80211_BAND_ATTR_VHT_MCS_SET, and NL80211_BAND_ATTR_VHT_CAPA,
all of which are parts extracted from the HT and VHT information
IE in 802.11, by calling functions from the IEEE 802.11 dissector.

Also dissect NL80211_BAND_IFTYPE_ATTR_IFTYPES.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body:
Sample file: [nl80211_get_wiphy.pcapng.gz](/uploads/372f0a64a5dc927b9935819a3701d08a/nl80211_get_wiphy.pcapng.gz)

New dissection:
